title: IIT Madras: overview, contacts and student portals
content:
# IIT Madras: overview, contacts and student portals

IIT Madras (IITM) is a residential institute in Chennai. Its Undergraduate Programmes page describes a self-contained campus with about 550 faculty, 9,700 students and 1,250 administrative and supporting staff. The homepage gives different, undated figures (2,105 UG, 4,112 PG, 746 MS research scholars, 2,963 PhD scholars, 591 faculty, 677 staff), so confirm current numbers on https://www.iitm.ac.in.

- **Postal address:** Indian Institute of Technology Madras, IIT P.O., Chennai 600 036, India.
- **Phone and email:** the contact page has no general phone number or email. Each office, department and centre has its own; use the directory at https://www.iitm.ac.in/directory. Campus map: https://www.iitm.ac.in/campus-map.
- **Email domain:** official addresses use iitm.ac.in. Students get an institute "smail" ID; the exact domain isn't spelled out on the pages read.

## Student links
- Fee payment portal: https://fees.iitm.ac.in/
- Hostels (Council of Wardens): https://ccw.iitm.ac.in/getHostelList
- Central Library: https://www.iitm.ac.in/academics/academic-facilities/central-library
- Academic calendar: https://www.iitm.ac.in/academics/academic-calendar
- Timetable: https://www.iitm.ac.in/academics/academic-services/timetable
- Wellness Community Centre: https://dost.iitm.ac.in/wellness-center
- Women's Forum: https://womensforum.iitm.ac.in/

The pages read did not show a student ERP login or placement page. Check https://www.iitm.ac.in/students.

title: IIT Madras admissions: routes by programme
content:
# IIT Madras admissions: routes by programme

The official pages give the routes below. They give no application dates, cut-offs or seat numbers; check the 2026 admission PDFs linked at the end.

## Undergraduate
- **B.Tech (4 years):** through JEE (Main) and JEE (Advanced); branch allotment by the Joint Admission Committee. JEE: https://jeeadv.ac.in/
- **Dual Degree B.Tech + M.Tech (5 years):** select engineering and science disciplines, through JEE (Main) and JEE (Advanced).
- **Dual Degree BS + MS:** Biological Sciences and Physics (entrance route not stated on the page).
- JoSAA counselling questions: the homepage points to askiitm.com.

## Postgraduate
| Programme | Route | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M.A. (2 yrs: Development Studies, Economics, English Studies) | GATE | http://gate.iitm.ac.in/ |
| M.Sc (2 yrs: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) | JAM | http://jam.iitm.ac.in/mscadm.php |
| M.Tech (2 yrs) | GATE | http://mtechadm.iitm.ac.in/ |
| MBA (2 yrs) | CAT score; also sponsored, defence, NRI and foreign candidates | https://doms.iitm.ac.in/ |
| EMBA (weekend, working professionals) | — | https://doms.iitm.ac.in/emba/ |
| Web-enabled M.Tech (working professionals) | — | https://cce.iitm.ac.in/course.html |

## PhD
See https://www.iitm.ac.in/academics/study-at-iitm/research-programmes (not read).

## 2026 admission documents
- UG: https://www.iitm.ac.in/sites/default/files/Others/UG_Admission_2026_updated.pdf
- PG: https://www.iitm.ac.in/sites/default/files/Others/PG_Admissions_2026_updated.pdf

title: IIT Madras fees, payments, hostels and academic calendar
content:
# IIT Madras fees, payments, hostels and academic calendar

## Fees
The fee structure is published as an image on https://www.iitm.ac.in/academics/academic-services/fees (separate structures for Indian and foreign nationals). Check amounts there.

Rules on the fees page:
- Semester fees are paid online according to the student's category.
- **No instalments**; the full fee is due by the deadline. **Late payment penalty: Rs. 2500.**
- Dual degree students pay M.Tech fees from the **9th semester**.
- Institute fees, hostel fees, advance dining charges and optional event fees (Shaastra, Saarang, E-summit) are paid on the Integrated Fee Payment Portal, https://fees.iitm.ac.in/ (desktop/laptop only). The passcode goes to the student's smail ID. Day scholars pay hostel-related amounts per the Hostel Fee Circular.
- Excess credit is refunded or adjusted in the next semester.
- Education loans: institute-fee loan account details are in https://fees.iitm.ac.in/assets/circular/tution_fee_loan.pdf; for hostel-fee loans, contact the Council of Wardens (CCW) office.
- **Failed payment** (money deducted): wait 3–5 working days; if not refunded, email chequeunit@iitm.ac.in with roll number, name and transaction ID.

## Hostels
20 hostels (5 for women, 15 for men), each with a faculty warden and a resident assistant warden, under the Council of Wardens: https://ccw.iitm.ac.in/getHostelList

## Academic calendar
Current calendar PDFs (dates not copied here; open them for term dates):
- Jul–Nov 2026: https://www.iitm.ac.in/sites/default/files/academic%20Caledar%20Files/Jul-Nov_2026.pdf
- Jan–May 2026: https://www.iitm.ac.in/sites/default/files/academic%20Caledar%20Files/Jan-May_2026.pdf

## Support
Wellness Community Centre: https://dost.iitm.ac.in/wellness-center · Dean of Students: https://www.iitm.ac.in/the-institute/dean-students
